applicability: Hypothesis chosen for a localized search change
checks: Fix target, control, positive, negative and zero-result cases before editing
steps: Request exact evidence and source via existing Host protocol
Select a source-backed editable block; propose one minimal change
Run protected tests and compare IDs, diagnostics and real before/after
Store rejected hypothesis and reason separately from verified outcomes
success: Independent Host validation passes; root acceptance alone decides completion
avoid: No changing test expectations to manufacture PASS
No treating more results as better relevance
Do not confuse a patch passing unit tests with mission completion
